# CONNECT without creds is 407 via ResponseWriter (no 200, no Hijack).
# Go 1.26.9+ net/http never reuses a connection after a CONNECT it did not
# hijack, so the 407 carries Connection: close and the server closes the TCP.
C: CONNECT {{HOST}} HTTP/1.1
C: Host: {{HOST}}
C:
S: HTTP/1.1 407 Proxy Authentication Required
S: Content-Length: *
S: Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
S: Date: *
S: Proxy-Authenticate: Basic realm="labmitm-proxy"
S: Connection: close
S:
S: proxy authentication required
